configurationDrift.summary: marketingAgent is declared deepseek-v4-pro in agentModels but actually constructed from workflowModels.marketing.default = local gemma4-12b.
11 Board targets declared sync are nevertheless accepted on explicit async and/or auto-forced async generic routes.
Six pipeline agents use pipeline reflection only on sync delegation; their async route is generic raw generate.
CAPABILITY_SMITH_AGENT_ALIASES participates in canonicalization but is missing from agentIdAliases, so capabilitySmith/capability-smith DB filters are not broadened.

Pending-result identities and consumers disagree: return identities include coding/deliberation/design/writer/filmmaker/musician without a pending processor or polling tool; PENDING_UPDATES_AGENT_IDS includes coding but omits knowledge, while processors exist for meta/automation/knowledge and the polling tool is exposed only by meta/automation.
Registry key metaAgent and META_AGENT_ID meta-agent are not declared as an alias pair and canonicalization can retain either spelling.
Eight registered helpers/reviewers are absent from agentModels: six producer helpers plus securityReviewAgent and performanceReviewAgent; their models are workflow-owned.

crossCuttingStaticFindings.summary: Async delegation records are persistent but execution is void executeDelegation in the API process; restart loses running work and there is no autonomous wake.
No registered agent has custom full-harness coverage for direct stream; only meta has direct generate patched.
withToolEnvelope does not accept/forward the Mastra ToolExecutionContext second argument, so wrapped tools lose mastra/agent/requestContext/suspend/resumeData/onProgress.
Async and omitted-resource delegation paths use agent/caller constants as memory resources, not originating user identity; mutable scopes can be shared across users.
Pipeline sync timeout uses Promise.race without abort; timed-out work may continue mutating. Async mode avoids that helper but removes pipeline reflection.
Full-harness timeout bounds the main generate call, while reflection/review/approval/GoalContract completion post-passes can exceed the same deadline.
Scheduled registered-agent execution is raw generate without explicit timeout/maxSteps override for every agent except meta, whose patched generate intercepts it.

effectiveObserved model is null for every profile because no model was invoked.
Mastra SDK default maxSteps, default Memory options for weatherAgent, provider retry behavior and raw-interface timeout behavior were not inferred.
Actual environment overrides, service availability, model health and storage URI were not inspected.
